text:
incident-bot: Paging @zack-oncall - SEV2: multiple tenant reads returning stale/incorrect KV prefix values for tenant 'acme-corp', increased error ratio and embedding mismatches. Auto-alert triggered at 21:04 UTC.

zack-oncall: acked, joining. can someone paste the alert graphs? what service?

maria-sre: seeing spike in `kv-prefix-miss` and `model-embedding-mismatch` from the routing layer. hit-rate for prefix `acme-*` dropped to 12% from 98% around 21:01.

jonathan-ops: logs show a batch of namespace migrations at ~20:58, looks like a stale mapping in edge-prefetcher. sending examples.

jonathan-ops: ```
2026-03-14T20:59:12Z prefet(charge): WARN prefix_mapping: missing mapping for acme-v2 -> falling back to acme-v1
2026-03-14T21:00:03Z routing: ERR embedding_mismatch tenant=acme shard=7 request_id=abc123
```

zack-oncall: if prefetcher is returning old mapping we need to protect customer correctness. Recommend immediate mitigation: 1) put tenant 'acme' into cache-bypass (force reads to authoritative store) 2) throttle their QPS to reduce pressure while we fix mapping 3) disable prefetch refresh jobs for that prefix. agree?

maria-sre: +1. bypassing cache for correctness is priority. throttling to 20% of usual QPS should buy time.

leo-pm: we need to coordinate customer comms — Eve, can support message the main acme contact that we're applying temporary protections?

eve-support: on it. sending a proactive note: "We detected an inconsistency affecting a subset of reads for your account. We're applying a temporary safeguard (reads will be consistent but may be slower)." Will update when mitigations complete.

sara-platform: config snippet to apply cache bypass in routing service: ```json
{
  "tenant": "acme-corp",
  "cache_policy": "BYPASS",
  "reason": "KV-prefix-mapping-inconsistency-2026-03-14",
  "expires_at": "2026-03-14T23:00:00Z"
}```

maria-sre: I'm going to apply this via the emergency config API. curl command: ```bash
curl -XPOST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OP_KEY' \
  https://control-plane.internal/configs/emergency \
  -d '{"target":"routing","patch":{"tenants":{"acme-corp":{"cache_policy":"BYPASS"}}}}'
```

deploy-bot: deploy started: emergency-config-v2026-03-14-2132 by maria-sre

deploy-bot: deploy success: emergency-config-v2026-03-14-2132 - rolled to 8/8 routing instances (duration 18s)

zack-oncall: config rolled. confirm bypass active?

maria-sre: verified via routing debug endpoint: `GET /debug/tenant/acme-corp` returns `cache_policy: BYPASS` and `active: true`. Also see immediate drop in `kv-prefix-miss` errors post-bypass, but latency increased ~120ms for those reads.

jonathan-ops: started throttling: `quota adjust acme-corp --read-qps 20% --note 'emergency throttle after cache-bypass'` done. Monitoring.

maria-sre: disabled prefetcher refresh for `acme-*` prefixes: `systemctl stop prefetcher && echo 'exclude: acme-*' > /etc/prefetcher/blacklist.yaml` and deployed. prefetcher logs now show no refresh attempts for acme.

jonathan-ops: also set a temporary routing fallback to synchronous DB reads if bypass fails: added `fallback=sync_db` to the tenant policy. snippet: `policy: {cache_bypass: true, fallback: sync_db}`

zack-oncall: monitoring error rate and customer impact dashboards. early signs: request success rate recovered to 99.6% for acme, embedding-consistency alerts cleared.

eve-support: sent update to acme: "Mitigation applied; reads are now consistent. We may see increased latency temporarily. Engineering is investigating root cause and will follow up with RCA." Customer replied: "Thanks. Please keep us posted. Perf hit is acceptable for now."

maria-sre: root cause hypothesis: during last-night's namespace migration there was a stale cache of prefix->model mapping in the prefetcher shards that didn't pick up the migration marker. This caused routing to serve older embeddings for some requests (correctness gap). Will run a compare between mapping table and prefetcher local cache.

jonathan-ops: collecting evidence: `SELECT count(*) FROM prefix_mappings WHERE migrated_at IS NULL AND prefix LIKE 'acme-%';` returning 0 on control DB but prefetcher local snapshot shows old version id 42 vs control 45.

sara-platform: plan to roll a consistent refresh across prefetcher shards: 1) ensure mapping table is authoritative 2) push refresh token 3) confirm shard snapshots updated 4) re-enable prefetcher for acme. We'll do that only after observed stability for 30m.

zack-oncall: agreed. update runbook and handoff to next on-call in 4 hours if stable. leaving `cache_bypass` with expiry ~2 hours out as precaution.

maria-sre: creating incident task list in tracker: - mitigate (done) - gather logs and mapping diffs (in progress) - coordinated refresh (blocked until stability) - customer RCA draft - postmortem writeup.

jonathan-ops: attaching small diffs: ```diff
--- prefetch_snapshot_v42.json
+++ authoritative_mapping_v45.json
@@ 
- "acme-v2": "model-A@rev42"
+ "acme-v2": "model-A@rev45"
```

eve-support: acme oncall forwarded a few request ids that saw wrong output earlier, sending to maria for deeper check.

maria-sre: will run replay tests against both rev42 and rev45 to quantify divergence. plan to re-enable prefetcher only if diffs are bit-for-bit identical for controlled test sets.

leo-pm: thanks everyone. Please leave the handoff note for next shift: include current mitigations (cache_bypass, throttles, prefetch disabled), ETA for refresh window, and customer comms copy.

zack-oncall: handoff: I'm on-call until 01:00 UTC. If anything regresses escalate to SRE lead. Current flags: `cache_bypass=true`, `read_qps=20%`, `prefetch_disabled_for_acme=true`.

incident-bot: Note: Pager duty acknowledgement recorded for zack-oncall at 21:06 UTC.

maria-sre: leaving a short playbook in the thread: 1) verify bypass with `GET /debug/tenant/acme-corp` 2) confirm `read_success_rate > 99%` 3) don't re-enable prefetcher until mapping version match 4) prepare RCA with timeline and bunting plan for future migrations.

zack-oncall: thanks. will monitor and escalate if error ratio climbs >1%.

deploy-bot: note: emergency-config-v2026-03-14-2132 marked as reversible (rollback available).

sara-platform: capturing timeline for postmortem: migration job started 20:56 UTC, prefetcher drift detected 21:00 UTC, alert 21:04 UTC, mitigations applied 21:32 UTC (bypass + throttle + disable prefetch).

maria-sre: closing loop here for now. will update thread with mapping diffs and replay results. next: prepare RCA draft for Monday. :white_check_mark:
